validation.browserEvidence: This batch passed 12 browser cases across all three engines: nine multiple-axis cases and three original example autofit regressions. Real pixels and SVG verify distinct ranges, exact context and pointer targets, byte-identical full-state restoration, bound primitive tags at fractional pixel ratios, and hidden columns. The right axis expands when an extreme enters view and contracts when it leaves. The actual built website passed 42 states across desktop and 390-pixel mobile layouts, with no page or example errors. A demonstrated badge overlap was fixed and its regression check passes. Final engine, autofit and built-site screenshots were inspected. Traffic uses fixtures rather than live brokers.
validation.website: 63 static pages built successfully; multiple-axis example verified through all seven control states at desktop and mobile widths in all three engines
validation.budgetChange: Native placement, visible column geometry, pointer routing and snapshot parsing add 1.25 kB to the base bundle (106.87 to 108.12) and 1.18 KiB to chart-only imports (66.13 to 67.31). Limits are now 108.25 kB base, 116.25 kB base plus trade, 246 kB terminal, 286 kB all tiers and 67.5 KiB chart-only. Axis menus remain in the optional widget; all optional-tier removal checks pass.
validation.review: Review closed an extra column from an empty secondary pane, legacy reassignment after a placement override, blank-cell drawing gestures and invalid untyped pane indices. Three additional failing regressions exposed lost hidden placement after removing reordered or already-vacant peers; configured ranks are now retained through restoration. Actual geometry, autofit, primitive placement, validation and host menu regressions demonstrated failures before their fixes. Full-state screenshots are byte-identical after placement restoration in all three engines. Axis metadata in indicator templates remains explicitly tracked.
validation.packageVerification: Full verify passed lint, typecheck, 7131 unit tests, seven endurance-harness checks, build, 436 example tests, declaration identity, measured size limits and tree-shake checks. Sixteen compiled-program checks and public adapter typechecking passed with the unchanged engine adapter.
